answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. What survives to the ledge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. A river of per-task receipts records who did what, and the raven of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
